segments.label: NEWS
segments.headline: Robots that learn from one demo

beats.narration: A new coworker can learn a task from seeing it once, but robots usually need hours or days of examples.
beats.eleven_text: [curious] A new coworker can learn a task from seeing it once, but robots usually need hours or days of examples.

beats.narration: So can a robot learn a new job from just one demonstration?
beats.eleven_text: [excited] So can a robot learn a new job from just one demonstration?

beats.narration: A new company says yes: a person shows the robot a task once, then steps back.
beats.eleven_text: [excited] A new company says yes: a person shows the robot a task once, then steps back.

beats.narration: And the robot does it on its own, with objects it has never seen.
beats.eleven_text: [excited] And the robot does it on its own, with objects it has never seen.

beats.narration: In an hour-long test, its robots placed a block seventy-four times out of seventy-four.
beats.eleven_text: [excited] In an hour-long test, its robots placed a block seventy-four times out of seventy-four.

beats.narration: If that holds up, teaching a robot becomes as quick as showing it once.
